patch_description:
The current ansatz uses excessive parameter sharing (3 distinct params) which severely limits model capacity. The second program achieved 0.58 score by using differentiated parameters (10 distinct params) with individualized XX/YY/ZZ gates, much better worst_group_margin (0.28 vs 0.00) and validation accuracy (0.97 vs 0.58).

The strategy is to:
1. Keep RY gates but with better differentiation (alternating or qubit-specific)
2. Add back RZ pre gates (removed in current)
3. Use diverse Ising gate types (XX, YY, ZZ) on different qubit pairs with individual parameters to allow the model to learn specialized interactions
4. Add post-layer RZ gates for phase adjustment
5. Keep total distinct params moderate (~8-10) for good generalization

This balances expressiveness (needed to separate hardest samples) with parameter economy (essential for generalization from small training set).
